prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Alberto, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Alberto trusts the staff who run the municipal pool.
Change to make: SOFTEN: add doubt, or make the claim milder and less certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ve heard some chatter about the pool potentially staying closed due to water quality issues, though it’s hard to say if there’s any real truth to it. We should probably wait for an official word before assuming anything is set in stone."
text: There’s some talk about the pool having water quality issues, though I’m not sure how much stock to put in those rumors. The staff usually keeps us well-informed, so I’d wait to hear what they have to say before worrying.
